messages:
Elena Voss: quick proposal  pilot 'signal clarity' to reduce noisy owner nudges. normalize role/title/company_size/MRR and only set `contactable=true` when clarity threshold met. low-risk canary.

Tom Kim: +1. need: canonical role mapping, fallback enrichment source, and explicit source_of_truth field on CRM. Also a kill-switch.

Priya Singh: definition: clarity_score = fields_present / expected_fields. expected_fields = [role, phone, company_size, mrr]. clarity>=0.75 => contactable. clarity<0.5 => low_clarity flag. sample_rate 3% for pilot.

Omar Khalid: infra plan: event from client -> enricher (if missing) -> playbook-runner evaluates rule -> set crm.contactable flag and crm.low_clarity tag -> route only if contactable. will implement idempotency via `event_id`. add per-owner throttle.

Elena Voss: sample event: `{"account_id":"acct_42","owner_id":"u_tom","role":"CTO","phone":null,"company_size":"SMB","mrr":null,"event_id":"evt-2026-42"}`.

Priya Singh: scoring tweak idea: contactable true => +3 health weight for 7d; low_clarity => -2 for 14d (ephemeral). telemetry tag `signal_clarity_pilot_v1`.

Tom Kim: playbook draft (staging):
```yaml
id: cs-signal-clarity-v1
trigger:
  type: event
  event_name: onboarding.signal_clarity
sample_rate: 0.03
conditions: []
actions:
  - run_enrichment:
      sources: [internal_enricher, third_party]
  - compute_clarity:
      fields: [role, phone, company_size, mrr]
  - set_crm_field:
      field: contactable
      value: "{{clarity >= 0.75}}"
  - set_crm_field:
      field: low_clarity_flag
      value: "{{clarity < 0.5}}"
  - route_to_owner:
      owner_field: owner_id
      only_if: contactable
meta:
  feature_flag: signal_clarity_pilot_v1
  dedupe_key: event_id
```

Omar Khalid: ops notes: add owner_rate_limit=40, and if routed_delayed >72h set crm.delayed_routing=true and ephemeral health penalty -1. also add an emergency disable tag for enterprise accounts.

Playbook Bot: playbook-runner: draft created in staging (cs-signal-clarity-v1).

Priya Singh: acceptance criteria: owner queue delta < 30, false route rate < 8%, clarity distribution stable across segments, enrichment failure < 2%. plan: 48h canary then decision.

CS Integrator Bot: scheduled staging deploy window tomorrow 02:30 UTC.

Elena Voss: thanks all. quick sync in #cs-ops tomorrow 11:00am PT to sign off. short thread, actionable plan. :white_check_mark:
